map.专利年费不交会怎样？: What happens if the patent annuity is not paid?
map.保护届满 = 起算日 + 法定保护年限（自然人著作:死亡后50年;法人著作:发表: Protection expiry = start date + statutory term (works by natural persons: 50 years after death; works by legal entities: 50 years after publication; invention 20 years; utility model 10 years; design 15 years; trademark 10 years)
map.判断一项专利/商标/著作权当前是否在保护期内、剩余有效年限，评估维权与许可价值。: Judge whether a patent, trademark or copyright is currently within its term and how many years remain, to assess enforcement and licensing value.
map.填写「作者死亡年份」。: Fill in "the year of death of the author".
map.填写「首次发表年份」。: Fill in "the year of first publication".
map.外观设计专利自 2021 年 6 月 1 日起申请的适用 15 年，此前申请适用: Design patents filed on or after 1 June 2021 get 15 years; earlier filings get 10 years.
map.未按规定缴纳年费的，专利权自应当缴纳年费期满之日起终止；终止后技术进入公有领域，: If the annuity is not paid as required, the patent right terminates from expiry of the period in which it should have been paid; after termination the technology enters the public domain and others may use it freely.
map.注册商标有效期 10 年自核准注册日起算，期满可续展，每次续展 10 年。: A registered trademark is valid for 10 years from the date of approval, and can be renewed for 10 years each time.
map.知识产权保护期计算 使用指南: Intellectual property term calculation usage guide
map.自然人作品保护期为作者终生及其死亡后 50 年；法人或非法人组织作品、视听作品保: For works by natural persons the term lasts the author's lifetime plus 50 years after death; for works by legal persons or unincorporated organisations and for audiovisual works it is 50 years from first publication (ending on 31 December of the 50th year).
map.著作权保护期怎么算？: How is the copyright term calculated?
map.著作权（自然人）保护至作者死亡后第50年的12月31日；著作权（法人或职务作品）: Copyright (natural person) lasts until 31 December of the 50th year after the author's death; copyright (legal person or work for hire) lasts until 31 December of the 50th year after first publication; invention patents 20 years, utility models 10 years and designs 15 years all run from the filing date; the exclusive trademark right runs 10 years from the date of approval and can be renewed on expiry. Enter the starting year or date to get the expiry date.
map.违约金计算器（按日利率/约定）: Liquidated damages calculator (by daily rate / agreement)
map.选择专利、商标或著作权等知识产权类型并输入起算日期，按对应法定期限计算保护期届满: Choose the intellectual property type (patent, trademark, copyright and so on) and enter the starting date; the expiry of the term and the remaining years are computed from the statutory period for that type, so the right holder can see the valid window.
